_comment: The config selftest.py and `site.py --fixtures` run against. Deliberately NOT the real config.json -- otherwise adding a title to the watchlist breaks every test until a fixture is written for it.
_comment_animation: Mirrors the real config: animation is IN, the Disney Jr. tier is not. exclude_animation is a server-side without_genres param, so it is inert against fixtures either way -- it is the local preschool filter these tests actually exercise.
